properties.kvalitet:
This site contains forests, heaths and mires. The area is important to forest-birds.
Gentiana pneumonanthe is included in Section 3.3 as an obligate host species of the vulnerable butterfly Maculinea alcon.
properties.karaktar: Large nature tract with coniferous and mixed woodland, mires, heaths and lakes.
properties.arter: Nattskärra, Orre, Pärluggla, Sparvuggla, Spillkråka, Storlom, Tjäder, Trädlärka

properties.kvalitet: Important reproduction area for seals.
properties.karaktar: Archipelago with rocky islets and skerries.

properties.kvalitet: Well preserved mire with representative vegetation types. The site is included in the National Mire Protection Plan.
properties.karaktar: Well preserved mire with representative vegetation types.

properties.kvalitet: The old oaktrees hosts rare invertebrates including Osmoderma eremita. They are also substrate for rare lichens as well as being an important landscape feature.
properties.karaktar: Partly overgrown wooded pasture with old hollow oaktrees and other broadleaves.

properties.kvalitet: The vulnerable moss species Bryhnia novae-angliae has a large and stable population in this site.
properties.karaktar: The site contains a brook surrounded by deciduous and mixed forests situated on a north sloping mountain side.

properties.kvalitet: Important reproduction area for seals and seabirds, notably black guillemot and razorbill.
properties.karaktar: Archipelago with rocky islets and skerries. Bird protection area.

properties.kvalitet: Two islands with species-rich communities of plants and insects, including several species on the National Red List. Part of the site (Älgön) is included in the National Conservation Plan for the Agricultural Landscape.
properties.karaktar: Two steep and hilly islands with heather-covered plateaus, groves of deciduous trees, ravines, cliff-faces and grazed meadows.

properties.kvalitet: One of the few known sites in Bohuslän with a stable population of the aquatic beetle Graphoderus bilineatus.
properties.karaktar: Dystrophic lake.

properties.kvalitet: Well preserved estuarine environment with shallow waters. Important area for migratory fish, notably salmon, trout and eel. Important reproduction area for gulls and terns. Important migration and wintering site for waterfowl.
properties.karaktar: Estuary in the river mouth of Nordre älv. The estuary is of "salt wedge" type. The site also contains rocky islets and skerries as well as large bays with shallow waters.
properties.arter: Asp, Blå kärrhök, Brun kärrhök, Brushane, Dubbelbeckasin, Dvärgbeckasin, Fisktärna, Gulärla, Knubbsäl, Kustlabb, Lax (i sötvatten), Salskrake, Skäggmes, Småfläckig sumphöna, Sångsvan, Tornfalk

properties.kvalitet: The vulnerable moss species Bryhnia novae-angliae has a large and stable population in this site.
properties.karaktar: The site includes a brook surrounded by alluvial forests and swamp woods with Alnus, Quercus, Tilia, Ulmus and Fraxinus.

properties.kvalitet: Oak and alder forests with a species-rich flora. Small natural river with important spawning sites for trout.
properties.karaktar: Small natural river surrounded by mixed alder, elm, ash and oak forest. Mountain slope with deciduous forests dominated by oaks and beeches.

properties.kvalitet: The oak woods are very good examples of their kind. They contain a great number of nationally red-listed species, especially fungi and epiphytic lichens. The shallow waters are important for fish-reproduction and for migrating and wintering waterfowl and wading birds.
properties.karaktar: Sundsby is an old manor surrounded by large deciduous forests, mainly with oak, situated on sloping mountain sides. The bays and inlets around Sundsby have shallow marine waters.

properties.kvalitet: Well preserved mires with representative vegetation types. The site is included in the National Mire Protection Plan. The marsh gentian (Gentiana pneumonanthe) and the alcon blue (Maculinea alcon) have good populations in the area.
properties.karaktar: The site holds a dystrophic lake surrounded by well preserved transition mires with representative vegetation types. The mires are surrounded by, partly boggy, coniferous woodland.

properties.kvalitet: The site contains (on the island of Härön) one of the best preserved agricultural landscapes along the coast of SW Sweden. The site is included in the National Conservation Plan for the Agricultural Landscape.
properties.karaktar: Island with a well preserved traditional agricultural landscape, including meadows, pastures and formerly grazed outlying lands.

properties.kvalitet: Narrow sea inlet with shallow waters. Important area for migrating waterfowl and waders. The shallow waters are important for fish-reproduction.
properties.karaktar: Narrow sea inlet with shallow waters.

properties.kvalitet: Kosterfjorden-Väderöfjorden contains around 200 species of animals and 9 species of algae which in Sweden occur only in this site. It is the only area in Sweden with coral reefs.
properties.karaktar: This site contains the most species-rich and diverse marine area in Sweden. Most of the reefs are situated in deep water and are strongly sloping. The maximum depth of water is 247 m.

properties.kvalitet: Well preserved herb-rich spruce forest with a repressentative lime influenced flora. Several threatened species.
properties.karaktar: Rocky slopes and a herb-rich spruce forest on partly calcarious soils. Several streams cut through the west facing rocky slope.

properties.kvalitet: The beech and oak woods are good examples of their kind. The beech woods contain some nationally red-listed moss and lichen species.
properties.karaktar: The site contains a large deciduous wood dominated by beech and oak.

properties.kvalitet: Important reproduction area for seals and seabirds, notably black guillemot.
properties.karaktar:
Archipelago with rocky islets and skerries. Seal protection area.
60% ligger i kontinental region och 40% ligger i boreal region.

properties.kvalitet: The site contains one of the best preserved agricultural landscapes along the coast of SW Sweden. The site is included in the National Conservation Plan for the Agricultural Landscape.
properties.karaktar: The site contains a well preserved traditional agricultural landscape, including species-rich pastures and oak woods.

properties.kvalitet: The beech and oak woods are very good examples of their kind. The beech woods contain a great number of nationally red-listed species, especially epiphytic lichens. There are also some red-listed bird species and a rich herb flora in parts of the site.
properties.karaktar: The site is characterized by old beech and oak woods situated on north sloping mountain sides. The higher parts of the site is dominated by Scots pine.

properties.kvalitet: Old beech wood with a rich flora and fauna.
properties.karaktar: Old beech wood with a rich flora and fauna.

properties.kvalitet: Regionally important for migratory and wintering waterfowl.
properties.karaktar: Former coastal bay situated near an large estuary now walled in and surrounded by industrial activities.
properties.arter: Bergand, Brushane, Knipa, Salskrake, Sångsvan, Vigg

properties.kvalitet: Important reproduction area for seabirds, notably black guillemot, and seals. Rich sea shore flora.
properties.karaktar: Archipelago with rocky islands, islets and skerries.
properties.arter: Fisktärna, Knubbsäl, Kustlabb, Orre, Skärsnäppa, Smalgrynsnäcka, Tobisgrissla, Tornfalk, Tumlare, Vitkindad gås

properties.kvalitet: Natural river with important spawning sites for salmon and trout.
properties.karaktar: Natural river with spawning sites for salmon and trout.

properties.kvalitet: Stor representativ platåmosse med höga ornitologiska värden. Häckande ljungpipare och grönbena.
properties.karaktar: Stor representativ platåmosse med vågformiga och oregelbundna strängstrukturer, lösbottenhöljor. Höga ornitologiska värden med häckande ljungpipare och grönbena. Området är i huvudsak opåverkat men med viss lokal påverkan av dikning.

properties.kvalitet: During the agricultural expansion of the 18th and 19th centuries great parts of this site became an almost treeless land with heaths formed by grazing. Since grazing in the outlying lands were abandoned a partly spontaneous reforestation of the landscape has taken place. In some places there are projects going on with the aim to restore the pastoral landscape. The site contains deciduous and coniferous forests, heaths and mires that have a rich birdlife with several species included in the National Red List.
properties.karaktar: Large nature tract where the higher, rocky areas are covered with forests and heaths. In several places there are valleys with mires, lakes or agricultural land.
properties.arter: Bivråk, Nattskärra, Orre, Skogsduva, Spillkråka, Sångsvan, Trädlärka

properties.kvalitet: Important area of wide mires and mosaics of coniferous woodland of natural caracter. The area is of great importance for the intresting landscape and for recreation.
properties.karaktar: A very large coherent area of old coniferous woodland and mires.

properties.kvalitet: Important reproduction area for seals and seabirds, notably arctic skua, black guillemot, gulls and terns.
properties.karaktar: Archipelago with rocky islands, islets and skerries.
properties.arter: Fisktärna, Gulärla, Knubbsäl, Kustlabb, Nattskärra, Sångsvan, Tobisgrissla, Tornfalk, Vitkindad gås

properties.kvalitet: The river and adjacent land is quite undisturbed and forms an important biotope for organisms that live in water and along shores. The water shows minor signs of acidification.
properties.karaktar: A river at the border to Norway. The surroundings consists of decideous forests along the river and coniferous forests further away.

properties.kvalitet: Old beech and oak wood with a species-rich flora.
properties.karaktar: Old beech and oak wood situated by a sea inlet.

properties.kvalitet: The area contains coniferous forests, deciduous forests and fens of high quality and big importance for several organisms. Many threatened or otherwise interesting plants are found in the area. There have been few disturbances and the forests have a primeval character.
properties.karaktar: This area is situated in a landscape dominated by coniferous forests. The terraine shows sharp hills as well as valleys, the latter in several cases containing smaller fens, marshes and streams. The forests have a primeval character. Habitats with a small area are 3260 (0,5 ha) and 9180 (0,5 ha).

properties.kvalitet: Well preserved and representative coastal landscape characterized by rocky areas broken up with heaths, meadows and marshes. Due to the calcareous soil and mowing the meadows and marshes have a rich flora.
properties.karaktar: Coastal landscape characterized by rocky areas broken up with heaths, meadows and marshes. Due to the calcareous soil the meadows and marshes have a rich flora.

properties.kvalitet: Natural river with important spawning sites for salmon and trout. The woodland, grassland and stream are very good examples of their kind. The ground flora, the lichen flora, the bird fauna, the land mollusc fauna and the fresh-water evertebrate fauna are well developed and rich.
properties.karaktar: Small natural river surrounded by deep cut ravine wood- and grassland. The woodland consists mainly of Ulmus, Quercus, Fraxinus, Alnus, Populus, Sorbus, Salix and Corylus. The grassland is well grazed.

properties.kvalitet: Valuable deciduous woodland habitat rich in decaying wood.
properties.karaktar: Broad-leaved deciduous wood rich in decaying wood and including a stream and a waterfall.

properties.kvalitet: Old oak and lime forests with a species-rich flora.
properties.karaktar: Old oak and lime forests situated by the sea.

properties.kvalitet: The shallow, marine habitats and the surrounding salt pastures are important migration and wintering sites for waterfowl and wading birds.The area is important for fish-reproduction.
properties.karaktar: A large bay with shallow marine waters and an estuary in the inner parts. The bay is surrounded by salt pastures and grazed meadows.

properties.kvalitet: The site is one of the most species-rich and diverse marine areas in Sweden. It is of great importance to marine invertebrates, fish and birds.
properties.karaktar: The site includes large areas with shallow marine waters which contain Zostera-meadows and biogenic reefs of Mytilus.

properties.kvalitet: Characteristic of the site are coniferous and mixed woodlands, partly with a longtime continuity and at a climax stage. The area is important to forest-birds, such as grouse, owls, woodpeckers and birds of prey.
properties.karaktar: Large forested plateau with pine forests, rocks, bogs and clear-water lakes.
properties.arter: Bivråk, Fiskgjuse, Gråspett, Järpe, Nattskärra, Orre, Pärluggla, Sparvuggla, Spillkråka, Storlom, Tjäder, Tretåig hackspett, Trädlärka

properties.kvalitet: The habitat includes threatened species of mosses, lichens and vascular plants.
properties.karaktar: Spruce forest growing in soil strongly influenced by subsoil water. About ten natural springs feeds several fens and a small river in the area.

properties.kvalitet: One of few ancient forests on the Swedish west coast. The forest has high biological values with numerous nationally red-listed species of invertebrates, cryptogams and birds. The site contains two habitats of priority: 9180 and 91E0.
properties.karaktar: Ancient forest of pine and oak at the sea-border.

properties.kvalitet: The lake is a good example of an oligotrophic lake in this area and is classified as of highest natural history interest in the county. It support typical birds of an oligotrophic lake and of old coniferous and mixed woodland. Parts of the site is very important for the rare Dendrocopus leucotos. The old woodlands holds oceanic licen species.
properties.karaktar: 23 areas around the the lake Stora Le. An oligotrophic lake with many islets in the north and steep cliffs i the south. Areas of natural old woodland holding many interesting oceanic licen species.
properties.arter: Fisktärna, Järpe, Nattskärra, Pärluggla, Sparvuggla, Spillkråka, Storlom, Tjäder, Tretåig hackspett

properties.kvalitet: The site contains an old beech wood with a rich flora of lichens and mosses, including several threatened or rare species on the National Red List.
properties.karaktar: This site contains an old beech wood with a rich flora of lichens and mosses.

properties.kvalitet: A watercourse supporting one of the regions best populations of Margaritifera margaritifera. Mostly surrounded by coniferous woodland.
properties.karaktar: Medium sized stream running through mainly coniferous woodland.

properties.kvalitet: Betade eller tidigare betade lövskogar med förekomst av grova ekar, askar, och lindar som hyser intressanta lavar, svampar och insekter.
properties.karaktar: Betade eller tidigare betade lövskogar med förekomst av grova ekar, askar, och lindar som hyser intressanta lavar, svampar och insekter.

properties.karaktar: A tarn surrounded by forests.

properties.kvalitet: Small natural river with important spawning sites for salmon and trout. The woodland and stream are very good examples of their kind. The fresh-water evertebrate fauna is well developed and includes Margaritifera margaritifera.
properties.karaktar: Small natural river surrounded by deep cut ravine wood- and grassland.

properties.kvalitet: Well preserved and representative pastoral landscape with a rich flora and fauna, including several species on the National Red List.
properties.karaktar: Three islands connected by low, narrow strips of land. Well preserved and representative pastoral landscape.

properties.kvalitet: Deciduous forest containing old trees with a rich flora of lichens.
properties.karaktar: Pastures with old oaks adjacent to beech and oak forests.

properties.kvalitet: Old beech and oak forest with a long-term continuity. Species-rich flora.
properties.karaktar: Old beech and oak forest rich in epiphytes and with a long-term continuity.

properties.kvalitet:
The site contains coniferous forests (incl. "western taiga", 9010), partly with long-term continuity and at a climax stage. The area has a rich birdlife.
During the agricultural expansion of the 18th and 19th centuries parts of this site became an almost treeless land with heaths formed by grazing. Since grazing in the outlying lands were abandoned a spontaneous reforestation of the landscape has taken place. Part of the site (Vargfjället) is included in the National Conservation Plan for the Agricultural Landscape.
properties.karaktar: Area of coniferous woodland, bogs and nutrition-poor lakes. Little influenced by human activities.
properties.arter: Järpe, Orre, Pärluggla, Sparvuggla, Spillkråka, Tjäder, Tretåig hackspett

properties.kvalitet:
The site is dominated by coniferous forests, partly with a longtime continuity and at a climax stage. The site also contains a few broad-leaved deciduous forests, wetlands and oligotrophic lakes. The area is important to forest-birds, such as grouse, owls, woodpeckers and birds of prey.

The habitats are representative for the region of west Sweden. The site has been a scientific research site for many years regarding air pollution impact on forests.
properties.karaktar:
The site is dominated by coniferous forests, partly with a longtime continuity and at a climax stage. The site also contains a few broad-leaved deciduous forests, wetlands and oligotrophic lakes.

The area is situated in a region dominated by fissure-valley landscape with a sharp topography, wide areas of bare rock and a thin moraine layer. The moraine is very poor in nutritiants. The area has a large share of small lakes.
properties.arter: Bivråk, Fiskgjuse, Järpe, Nattskärra, Nötkråka, Orre, Pärluggla, Sparvuggla, Spillkråka, Storlom, Tjäder, Tretåig hackspett

properties.karaktar: This site consists of several dispersed areas of fens and small ponds in a landscape dominated by coniferous forests. The different parts of this site are Stora Skarnhålan, Svällesjön and Bergsjön.

properties.kvalitet: Noraneälven utgör ett gott exempel på sin naturtyp. Flytblads- och undervattensvegetationen är väl utvecklad med flera för naturtypen karakteristiska arter, så som Potamogeton alpinus, P. praelongus och Myriophyllum spicatum. De två senare arterna är dessutom relativt sällsynta såväl för regionen som för landet i sin helhet.
properties.karaktar: Långsamflytande vattendrag med väl utvecklad flytblads- och undervattensvegetation.

properties.kvalitet: Shallow eutrophic lake fringed with reeds, marshes, meadows and arable land. The lake has a rich birdlife including several species of duck, marsh harrier and grey heron.
properties.karaktar: Shallow, eutrophic lake fringed with reeds, marshes, meadows and arable land.

properties.kvalitet: Large, unexploited and representative archipelago with a few islands and several rocky islets and skerries. The islets are important reproduction places for seabirds. The area is of great importance for recreational activities.
properties.karaktar: Large archipelago with a few islands and several rocky islets and skerries.

properties.kvalitet: The site contains a representative and in many places well preserved pastoral landscape. The flora is very rich and contains several species included in the National Red List.
properties.karaktar: Two islands containing well preserved pastoral landscape, heaths, deciduous forests and rocky areas.

properties.kvalitet: This site is included in the swedish Ramsar List (List of Wetlands of International Importance). It contains a combination of shallow marine waters and salt marshes affected by grazing. It is an important area for migrating and wintering waterfowl. The Zostera-vegetation of the shallow waters is of great importance for fish-reproduction.
properties.karaktar:
A large bay with shallow marine waters and several rocky islets. The bay is surrounded by salt pastures and grazed meadows.

Området går genom två biogeografiska regioner. EU-kommissionen tog beslut om den kontinentala delen 200412 och den boreala delen 200501.

properties.kvalitet: The site contains old beech forests, wooded pastures and old coniferous forests. The site has a species-rich fauna as well as flora, including several redlisted species of epiphytic lichens, fungi and beetles.
properties.karaktar: Manor with old beech forests, wooded pastures and old coniferous forests.

properties.kvalitet: The site contains a combination of shallow marine waters and salt marshes affected by grazing. It is an important migration and wintering site for waterfowl and wading birds, and is one of the very few remaining breeding sites for Calidris alpina schinzii in South-west Sweden. The site is included in the National Conservation Plan for the Agricultural Landscape.
properties.karaktar: Shallow bay lined with salt pastures and grazed meadows.
properties.arter: Brushane, Fisktärna, Grönbena, Gulärla, Ljungpipare, Myrspov, Sydlig kärrsnäppa

properties.kvalitet: The site contains one of the few remaining old coastal deciduous forests in SW Sweden.The forest has an extremely rich lichen flora, including several threatened or rare species on the National Red List. The site is included in the National Conservation Plan for the Agricultural Landscape.
properties.karaktar: The area contains an old deciduous forest of tall-grown elms, ashes and oaks.

properties.kvalitet: The shallow, marine waters are important for fish-reproduction.
properties.karaktar: Narrow sea inlet with shallow waters.

properties.kvalitet: The stream with surrounding Alnus and Fraxinus woodland is a very good example of its kind and support important species such as Salmo salar and Alcedo attis.

properties.kvalitet: The old oak wood is a very good example of its kind. The area is rich in dead wood and old trees and holds a number of nationally red-listed species.
properties.karaktar: Old deciduous forest, mainly with oak and beech, situated on a peninsula in a lake.

properties.kvalitet: A large unexploited forest area of first and second generation coniferous woods. The habitats are representative for the region of west Sweden.
properties.karaktar: The area is situated in a fissure-valley landscape with a sharp topography, wide areas of bare rock and a thin moraine layer. The moraine is very poor in nutriants. The area has a large share of small lakes.

The Woodland and stream are both very good examples of their kind. They support a number of important species. 

Sollumsån och delar av den omgivande lövskogen utgör goda exempel för sitt slag. Bottenfaunan i vattendraget är artrik med flera rödlistade arter. Beståndet av  flodpärlmussla är reproducerande, vilket är ovanligt i de södra delarna av landet.
properties.karaktar:
Deep cut ravine woodland mainly consisting of Alnus, Fraxinus, Quercus, Ulmus and Betula. The ground flora is well developed and rich.

Djupt nedskuren åravin, huvudsakligen täckt med löv- och blandskog. Dominerande träslag är Alnus glutinosa, Betula sp., Fraxinus exelsior, Picea abies, Prunus padus samt Corylus avellana. I områdets nordgräns finns ett vattenfall, 5 m högt, följt av forsande och mot NV mer lugnflytande partier.

properties.kvalitet: This kind of habitats appears as spots in the landscape, where several rare species kan exist. The area is quite undisturbed and well preserved.
properties.karaktar: This site consists of several dispersed areas of fens and small ponds in a landscape dominated by coniferous forests. The different parts of this site are Valdalssjön and Hagens småvatten.

properties.kvalitet: Idefjorden is one of the most species-rich and diverse marine areas in Sweden.
properties.karaktar: Idefjorden is a silled fjord with an estuary in the inner part. Reefs are situated on the strongly sloping fjord sides.

properties.kvalitet: The river is important to several fish species, but also to other organisms living in och close to water. Among all disturbed parts, there are also undisturbed and natural spots.
properties.karaktar:
The area consists of a river with both slow and rapid flowing parts. The surroundings consists of agricultural land, urban territories and deciduous forests.

Området går genom två biogeografiska regioner. EU-kommissionen tog beslut om den kontinentala delen 200412 och den boreala delen 200501.

properties.kvalitet: The site is one of the most species-rich and diverse marine areas in Sweden. It is of great importance to marine invertebrates, fish and birds.

properties.kvalitet: Reproduction area for gulls, terns and seal. The site is an important fishing area and a reproduction area for lobster and crab.
properties.karaktar: Large marine area with a lot of islets, reefs and well developed "woods" of Fucus and Laminaria.

properties.kvalitet: Of great importance due to its size and relative wildness. The area is a rift-valley landscape with uniqe and very caracteristic formations dominated by cladonia-rich bare rour pinewood and its typical species such as Tetrao tetrix, T. urogallus and Caprimulgus europaeaus.
properties.karaktar: Oligotrophic rift-valley lakes. Cladonia-rich, bare roch pine wood.

properties.kvalitet: Well preserved and representative coastal landscape characterized by rocky areas broken up with heaths, meadows and marshes. Due to the calcareous soil and mowing the meadows and marshes have a rich flora.
properties.karaktar: A species rich and well preserved alkaline fen close to the shore with several typical species and some nationally rare plants.

properties.kvalitet: The site contains a combination of habitats of high conservation value, including shallow marine waters, salt marshes and dry heaths with a vegetation characterized by grazing. The salt marsh areas and shallow waters are important sites for migrating and wintering waterfowl and wading birds. The site is included in the National Conservation Plan for the Agricultural Landscape.
properties.karaktar: Shallow bay lined with salt pastures and grazed meadows.

Wetlands in the site are included in the National Mire Protection Plan. The site is included in the National Conservation Plan for the Agricultural Landscape.
properties.karaktar: Coastal landscape characterized by rocky areas broken up with grazed heaths, meadows and marshes. Due to the calcareous soil the meadows and marshes have a rich flora.

properties.karaktar: Natural river surrounded by broad-leaved deciduous forests.

properties.kvalitet: Island with a well preserved and representative coastal landscape including rocky areas, heaths and meadows. Due to grazing, mowing and the calcareous soil the meadows have a rich flora.
properties.karaktar: Island with a well preserved and representative coastal landscape including rocky areas, heaths and meadows. The landscape is strongly characterized by the fissured gneiss bedrock.

properties.kvalitet: The shallow, marine habitats and the surrounding salt pastures are important migration and wintering sites for waterfowl and wading birds.The area is important for fish-reproduction.
properties.karaktar: The site contains shallow coastal waters connected to the sea by narrow straits. The bays are partly surrounded by salt pastures.

properties.kvalitet: Betydelsefullt område för fågellivet, så väl för häckande, rastande och övervintrande arter. I områdets våtmarker förekommer mossan Hamatocaulis vernicosus, käppkrokmossa.
properties.karaktar: Dalgång med stort vattendrag, Nordre älv, som omges av våtmarker, odlingsmark och lövskog.

properties.kvalitet: Large, representative and undisturbed raised bog with a rich bird-life. The site is included in the National Mire Protection Plan.
properties.karaktar: Öjemossen is a large and undisturbed active raised bog.

properties.kvalitet: A very well developed and representative example of a raised bog complex. The fen support a species rich and for the region rare flora including red-listed species. The area is important for several bird species and includes lek-sites for Tetrao tetrix.
properties.karaktar: A large complex of active raised bogs and a herb-rich, slightly slooping fen. The bog-plains are very rich in hydro-morphological structures. The mire is surrounded by coniferous woodlands.
properties.arter: Grönbena, Järpe, Ljungpipare, Orre, Tjäder, Trana

properties.kvalitet: Musön ligger i yttersta delen av Fjällbackaskärgården och rymmer ett av de få kvarvarande småskaliga jordbrukslandskapen i skärgården. Ön hyser stor variation i hävdberoende naturtyper och arter.
properties.karaktar: Skärgårdsö med småskaligt jordbrukslandskap. Ön har en starkt uppbruten berggrund vilket har skapat en stor variation i hävdberoende naturtyper. Stora delar av de flacka bergbundna områdena hyser stora betespåverkade utmarker med vackra gräs- och ljunghedar. På skalgrus förekommer  artrika kalkfuktängar, strandängar och kalktorrängar och utmed bergbranter märks artrika randlövskogar och ädellövsnår.

properties.kvalitet: Old growth coniferous forests and a small natural river with a large number of red-listed species.
properties.karaktar: Deep cut canyon/ravine with old coniferous forest and a small natural river.

properties.kvalitet:
The site is dominated by coniferous forests, partly with a long-term continuity and at a climax stage. The site also contains a few broad-leaved deciduous forests, wetlands and oligotrophic lakes. The area is important to forest-birds, such as grouse, owls, woodpeckers and birds of prey.

The habitats are representative for the region of west Sweden. The site has been a scientific research site for many years regarding air pollution impact on forests.
properties.karaktar:
The site is dominated by coniferous forests, partly with a long-term continuity and at a climax stage. The site also contains a few broad-leaved deciduous forests, wetlands and oligotrophic lakes.

The area is situated in a region dominated by fissure-valley landscape with a sharp topography, wide areas of bare rock and a thin moraine layer. The moraine is very poor in nutritiants. The area has a large share of small lakes.

properties.kvalitet: Gullmarsfjorden is one of the most species-rich and diverse marine areas in Sweden. It is an important reproduction area for seal. The site contains a number of nationally red-listed fish species. The shallow bays with Zostera-meadows are reproduction areas for fish and shellfish.
properties.karaktar:
Gullmarsfjorden is a silled fjord with estuaries in the inner part. Reefs are situated on the strongly sloping fjord sides.

Området går genom två biogeografiska regioner. EU-kommissionen tog beslut om den kontinentala delen 200412 och den boreala delen 200501.

properties.kvalitet: Well preserved mires with representative vegetation types. The site is included in the National Mire Protection Plan.
properties.karaktar: The site is dominated by several well preserved mires with representative vegetation types. The mires are surrounded by woodland with coniferous as well as broad-leaved trees. A small natural river runs through the area.

properties.kvalitet: Natural, undisturbed river with a very species-rich invertebrate fauna.
properties.karaktar: Kynne älv is a relatively large, natural river with clear water. It is part of Enningdalsälven water system. It runs between the two lakes S Kornsjön (134 m above sea level) and S Bullaresjön (44 m above sea level). In the lower reaches of the river there are rapids with a 70 m height of fall.

properties.kvalitet: The red-listed newt Triturus cristatus has a large and stable population in this site.
properties.karaktar: The site includes a shallow pond on a flat rock. The water is supplied from a spring and has a very good quality.

properties.kvalitet: The site contains wooded pastures with old oaks and limes. The site has a species-rich coleopterous fauna, including several redlisted species, and a species-rich flora of epiphytic lichens.
properties.karaktar: The site is situated by a shallow coastal bay and contains salt pastures and wooded pastures with several old oaks and limes.

properties.kvalitet: The deciduous woods contain a number of nationally red-listed species, among them Vertigo angustior.
properties.karaktar: The site contains deciduous woods near a steep mountain side and along a small natural river.

properties.kvalitet: Site for Dytiscus latissimus and Graphoderus bilineatus.
properties.karaktar: Small lake near village.

properties.kvalitet: The site contains a combination of habitats of high conservation value, including shallow marine waters and salt pastures. The shallow waters are important for fish-reproduction. The salt pastures and shallow waters are important sites for migrating and wintering waterfowl and wading birds. Part of the site (Ramsön) is included in the National Conservation Plan for the Agricultural Landscape.
properties.karaktar:
Coastal area with shallow marine waters and rocky islets. The shores have salt pastures and grazed meadows.

Området går genom två biogeografiska regioner. EU-kommissionen tog beslut om den kontinentala delen 200412 och den boreala delen 200501.

properties.kvalitet: Large areas of well managed water meadows important for migrating wetland birds and rare beetles.
properties.karaktar: Grazed watermeadows next to two farmland eutrofic lakes.

properties.kvalitet: Shallow, eutrophic lake of importance to reproducing and migrating waterfowl.
properties.karaktar: Shallow, eutrophic lake.

properties.kvalitet: The site is one of the most species-rich and diverse marine areas in Sweden. The shallow marine waters and salt meadows are important for migrating and wintering waterfowl and wading birds.
properties.karaktar: Åbyfjorden is a narrow and relatively shallow sea inlet. The inner parts of the bays have shallow waters and salt meadows. The surroundings are hilly and contains rocky areas and deciduous woods.

properties.kvalitet: Representative heath-landscape partially managed by advanced heath-cultivation. The site contains two habitats of priority: 6230, 7110.
properties.karaktar: A landscape on rocky hills with heathlands, oak forests and coniferous forests. Most of the forest is the first generation after heath.

properties.kvalitet: Known site for the rare beetle Osmoderma eremita. The old oak trees are of gerat importance for the beetle.
properties.karaktar: Earlier park area with old oaktrees, now overgrown.

properties.kvalitet: Well developed marshes. One of the larger solid islets with nature forest with rather rich occurrence of dead wood.
properties.karaktar: The area is part of a larger mire complex and consists of open fens, heath (covered with bushes) and nature forest.

properties.kvalitet: Öppet hed- och hällmarkslandskap med sällsynta växter som strandvial, ostronört och strandvallmo och den hotade kustgentianan.
properties.karaktar: Området är ett av bohuskustens mest exponerade områden. Det utsatta läget och bete har format ett mycket öppet hed- och hällmarkslandskap.

properties.kvalitet: Rapid flowing watercourse, open even in winter. Important wintering site for several species duck and other bird species. Surrounded by broadleaved decidous woodland. Reproductionarea for Salmo salar.
properties.karaktar: Large stream with both slow and fast flowing parts. Surrounded by mainly broadleaved decidous woodland on clay.

properties.kvalitet: Representativt myrkomplex med stora kärr-och skogsmiljöer med stort naturvärde. Orördhet och mångformighet är värdefullt för fågellivet.
properties.karaktar: Myrmosaik med inslag av barrskog.

properties.kvalitet: Well preserved mire with representative vegetation types. The site is included in the National Mire Protection Plan.
properties.karaktar: Well preserved mire with representative vegetation types.

properties.kvalitet: Well preserved mire with representative vegetation types. The site is included in the National Mire Protection Plan.
properties.karaktar: Well preserved mire with representative vegetation types.

properties.kvalitet: The site includes large deciduous woods with several nationally red-listed species. Parts of the oak woods have a species-rich herb flora. The natural river holds important fish like salmon and trout.
properties.karaktar: The site contains large deciduous woods situated on mountain sides and along a small natural river.
